name: DYCD Runaway and Homeless Youth (RHY) Demographics and Services (Local Law 86)
description: This dataset contains demographic and service information for New York City's Runaway and Homeless Youth (RHY) programs, reported under Local Law 86. Each row covers a given year and demographic group (such as age, gender, race/ethnicity, or sexual orientation), broken down by category, with counts for crisis services and transitional independent living (TIL) services. The paired columns (crisis_services and crisis_services_1, til and til_1) appear to hold related counts or comparison values for each service type. With roughly 539 sampled rows and seven columns, the data supports analysis of which youth populations use crisis shelters versus longer-term transitional living programs, year-over-year trends in service demand, and demographic disparities in access to homeless youth services. It would be useful for program planning, policy evaluation, equity analysis, and public reporting on youth homelessness in New York City.
